history_source: E1 training queries only, immutable; both Keep and Skip records kept
selection: validation real graph replay: maximize (baseline model calls - actual logical calls)/baseline calls subject to <=0.2pp recall loss; ties lower false skips then stricter thresholds; test never chooses deployable settings
R1: union of historical learned Skip marks by node; any historical Skip suffices; different from legacy contribution global mark
R2: single nearest historical Query; reuse its node Skip marks, no distance cutoff
R3: closest normalized state among ALL same-node historical Keep/Skip records; reuse only if closest label Skip and distance<=scut
R4: among same-node records from top3 historical Queries passing qcut, choose closest state; reuse if Skip and ds<=scut; both finite thresholds
R5: top3 Queries passing qcut; at least votes distinct available histories and ALL available same-node histories vote Skip; absent records do not vote
OracleA: free knowledge of fresh current Skip; only reuse union-history Skip when current model also Skip; unavailable online; fresh-score shadow is outside latency pass
OracleB: exact multiple-choice quality-budget optimization over already replayed frozen strategy trajectories per query; budget0.2pp, baseline option allowed; exact optimum within evaluated trajectory menu, NOT unrestricted combinatorial upper bound
static: baseline trajectories only, no final-recall claims; validation used for sweep; held-out test diagnostics after lock
graph: planning pass physically scores fresh model for diagnostics; tape pass really bypasses inference for reused decisions and verifies node/state/path parity
latency: warm graph replay of precomputed decision tapes, excludes query-neighbour and state matching/maintenance; includes O(1) tape access and parity checks; three randomized repeats; NOT deployed cache latency
eligible: all live cache-miss model decision events; ReuseRate=reused/live eligible; ModelSaving=(fixed R0 calls - actual tape calls)/fixed R0 calls; path changes can separate these
false_skip_rate: reused Skip with shadow fresh Keep / all shadow fresh Keep on corresponding live path; also report erroneous fraction among reused
quality: Recall@10 relative to exact SIFT1M GT; aggregate recall budget, not per-query guarantee
legacy_baseline: retain E1 contribution-based global_once separately; not rename its rule to R1
